title: The Fat Pip
lines: A pip is at the mat.
Tip the pip at the pit, Tim.
The pip is at the pit!
Sam! Sis! The pip is fat!
Sit at it, Tim. It is a fat pip!

questions.ask: Where did Tim tip the pip?
questions.listenFor: Into the pit, the little hole he sat by. It is said in the third line. Point at that line and let your child read it again.

questions.ask: What did Sam do to the pit?
questions.listenFor: Patted it, to pack the dirt down. You are listening for the word pat. A one word answer is a fine answer.

questions.ask: What do you think the pip will turn into? Tell me why you think so.
questions.listenFor: A pip is a seed, so a plant or a tree is a lovely answer, but so is anything with a reason behind it. Listen for the why, not the what.
